steps.title: Pick a class and run the MSQ
steps.text: The Main Scenario Quest (blue quest markers) unlocks almost everything: dungeons, trials, Duty Finder and mounts.
tips: Always pick up the next blue-marker quest in the Main Scenario list.
Do side quests and Hunting Log entries for bonus XP while you level.

steps.title: Level 15–17: Sastasha, Tam-Tara Deepcroft, Copperbell Mines
do: Queue via the Duty Finder once the MSQ unlocks each duty.
Dungeons give large XP and are required to advance the MSQ.
tips: Tanks: pull in groups and mark targets. Healers: top off before big pulls. DPS: follow the tank.

steps.title: Level 20–28: Halatali, Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak, Haukke Manor
tips: Stay out of ground AoE telegraphs (orange shapes).

steps.title: Level 32–50: Brayflox's Longstop, Stone Vigil, Dzemael Darkhold, Aurum Vale, Castrum Meridianum, The Praetorium
tips: Castrum Meridianum and The Praetorium are MSQ-gated at 50 and lead into the end of A Realm Reborn.

steps.title: Daily routine
do: Roulettes: Leveling, Main Scenario, Trials, Alliance Raid (first clear each day gives big bonus XP).
Check the reset timers in the footer (daily/weekly).
tips: Rest XP builds while logged out in an inn – log out in a city.
